note: RSS feeds for the hourly monitor's prefilter (src/feed_prefilter.py). Every URL was fetched and parsed on 2026-10-15; reviewed 2026-10-31 (Cornucopia and DW's two small feeds out, DW's full feed, the Nordic and Baltic public broadcasters, Politico Europe, Defense News, EUvsDisinfo, Meduza and The Insider in). Tier follows config/methodology.json where the outlet is named there; tier_note marks the ones it does not name. Reuters, AP, TT, NATO, Forsvarsmakten, Sakerhetspolisen, FOI and the Government Offices have no working public feed and are left to the web search.
